id: \bCongratulations on winning your third match. \nYour next battle will be on the Grass stage.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your third match. \nYour next battle will be on the Grass stage.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il tuo terzo incontro. \nLa tua prossima lotta sarà sul campo Erba.
